narratives.Description: bug(ts-check-lane): release Step 5 poisons vitest with DEFT_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_GH_VERBS
narratives.Overview:
## In plain English

`task release` Step 5 injects `DEFT_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_GH_VERBS=1` into `task check` via `releaseSubprocessEnv`. `sanitizeTsLaneEnv` strips the default-branch bypass and `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` (#4506) but not this key. Nested `close-via-app` tests then fail because `assertNoDeftAllowEscape` treats any `DEFT_ALLOW_*=1` as a measured violation.

This is why v0.119.1 production Step 5 printed `Tests 2 failed | 17771 passed` three times, then went green when the same file was run outside the release env.

## Slice (this issue)

Add `DEFT_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_GH_VERBS` (`DESTRUCTIVE_GH_GATE_BYPASS_ENV`) to `TS_LANE_POISON_ENV_KEYS` in `packages/core/src/ts-check-lane/run-lane.ts`, same family as #4506. Nested vitest must not inherit the release subprocess bypass.

Do not weaken `assertNoDeftAllowEscape`. Do not stop `releaseSubprocessEnv` from setting the bypass for git/gh. Do not lower coverage. Do not implement #4628 here.

## Repro

- `pnpm exec vitest run --coverage=false packages/core/src/one-pr-unit/close-via-app.test.ts` → 4 passed
- same with `DEFT_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_GH_VERBS=1` → 2 failed:
  - App consume-then-close > refuses missing claimed set
  - App consume-then-close > consumes remaining members after bind
- Tee: `.deft/check-tees/no-session/45876-43f20aee.log` (and `38360-2c94cdda.log`)

Received: `DEFT_ALLOW_* is a measured violation, not an escape from one-PR-unit App close (DEFT_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_GH_VERBS)`

## Acceptance

- `sanitizeTsLaneEnv` deletes `DEFT_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_GH_VERBS`
- `close-via-app.test.ts` passes when the parent env has that key set to `1`
- `task release` Step 5 / `ts:check-lane` no longer fails those two tests solely because the release env leaked
- Existing #4506 strips (scope pin, default-branch bypass, check-mode) stay

Not this issue: leftover-closeout Closes/P1 waiter (#4628); Phase 1 red-tip; FAIL-title hatch; mint TTL.

Refs #4506, #4494, #4628
